title: OpenSeeker linked its source repository and 30B SFT model
summary: On 2026-03-18, the OpenSeeker thread linked to the project's GitHub repository and to the Hugging Face page for OpenSeeker-v1-30B-SFT. From the dated links alone, this is a material public source-and-model availability milestone. The links do not establish release notes, capabilities, licensing, benchmark results, or the purpose of the additional hf.ru link.
